verdict.rationale: Orama ships its own embedding capability in both its offerings. The OSS embeddings plugin generates vectors at insert and search time. Orama Cloud generates text embeddings automatically with local models and lets you pick the embedding model per collection, so no self-run pipeline is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed documentation of the available models and the plugin's configuration options.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use built-in or managed embedders so documents and queries are vectorized without running my own embedding pipeline

citations.quote: This plugin generates embeddings for your documents at insert and search time, allowing you to perform vector and hybrid searches on your documents.
Orama Cloud generates text embeddings automatically for your data using local, high-quality models.
When you create a collection, you can choose its language (English, Spanish, etc.), and the embedding model you want to use.
The plugin will automatically convert this text to vector for you
